gist: Pottery with Lena Fischer at her Kiln House studio: wheel sessions, firing Nia's pots and glaze notes. Nia returned to the wheel on 18 May after months away, and Lena said her walls were still too thick [n57, n185]; a June session produced six bowls, two of which survived [n79]. Firing invoices of £30 arrived 7 May, 14 June, 2 July and 29 July [n282, n437, n542, n678]. Glaze notes: tenmoku needs thick application, shino crawls over dust, and speckled oatmeal is best at cone 6 [n246]. The wheel now lives in the basement store at Alder Street [n208]. Nia got a market stall, and Lena says the kiln fills up before Christmas, so book firings for 20 and 27 Nov [n1466]. Open task: book two late-Nov firing slots, due 10 Nov [n1915]. Past: the Lisbon ceramics fair with Lena on 10 Oct [n1304]. Suspicious: nothing material; the kiln message was sent on two consecutive days [n1424, n1425].
